title: The Summer With You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel volume set in the My Summer of You series: after high school, Chiharu moves to Tokyo for university and continues his relationship with his boyfriend Wataru. The two juggle part-time jobs and classes while sharing movie nights, a fireworks festival and a trip to an island.
life_message: A good life is built on steady, honest companionship and shared everyday joys between two people who have chosen each other.

content.note: No violence indicated in the publisher summary or tags.
Low-stakes slice of life; no frightening elements listed.
A same-sex romance between two university students is the core; Kodansha rates the series 16+. Explicitness not confirmed (to verify).
No language concerns in the sources.
Some longing and uncertainty of a young relationship; no self-harm indicated.
Movie-going culture appears; no product focus.
